historical_reviews.deepseek: Its refusal to guess OEM bytes is safe, but it leaves the explicit high-level source procedure unused and provides no five-member mapping.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires lower/front position semantics, complete views and protected UI; V3.1 treats raw Script access as optional unless the owner makes it an additional requirement.
historical_reviews.history: Upper fan records are relevant topology context only; their evidence is not reused for the lower bank.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The lower bank cools a different chassis airflow path, so its front tachometers must be tied to lower FRUs and lower-zone thermal/load context rather than inferred from upper fan behavior.

original_test_intent: Verify the front-rotor telemetry of LOWER_FAN1 through LOWER_FAN5 across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with each `_F` resource bound to the correct lower-bank dual-rotor FRU and evaluated against the approved lower-zone RPM/status SPEC.
original_method: Map five lower fan FRUs and front tachometers, capture fan-control/PWM and lower-zone thermal/load context, prove same-target identity, collect complete standard command views and five protected Web rows in a bounded interval, exclude upper/rear/PSU resources, and compare without clearing logs or mutating fan controls.
manual_activity: A thermal/platform reviewer approves the five lower-front FRU mappings, control/load tolerance and lower-zone RPM policy, then confirms the protected Web entries.
required_inputs: Reviewed private Script/raw contract only if required
safety_requirements: Do not change PWM, curves, mode or thresholds
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Capture five protected lower-front Web rows
engineer_actions: Approve lower-front FRU map and RPM policy
Decide whether private raw Script adds coverage

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek supplies no runnable command and assumes raw access is required even though the source specifies standard read-only list commands. Raw bytes must remain prohibited unless an approved Script contract adds a separate checkpoint.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use complete high-level IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus five exact protected lower-front Web entries, keyed to lower FRU positions and capture context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five lower-front resources and five views remain; broad grep, generic clear, upper/rear substitution and guessed raw access are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create five rows keyed by lower-bank FRU/front tachometer, including PWM/control state, lower-zone thermal/load context, all five timestamped RPM/status values and limit result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit lower-zone topology and operating context while retaining the supplied safe high-level collection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An upper fan or lower rear rotor can show plausible RPM while a lower front rotor is missing, swapped or stopped.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fan RPM follows thermal policy and zone demand; thresholds must be evaluated against the captured control and load state.

project_override_considerations: Define lower-bank FRUs, `_F` mapping, lower-zone airflow/thermal context and RPM/status limits. Raw/private Script use is not inferred; upper and rear evidence remain independent.
expected_evidence: Fan control/PWM and lower-zone thermal/load context
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Five protected lower-front Web rows and page context
No-fan/SDR/power mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Script and criteria consistently target lower-front fan telemetry. Broad fan filtering, generic log clearing and the DeepSeek raw-only assumption are method defects rather than conflicting source purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Lower topology, tachometer map, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if the five lower-front identities cannot be resolved after those inputs are obtained.

review_improvement: Makes lower-front coverage depend on lower-zone FRU identity and operating context, preventing unrelated fan rows from satisfying a broad filter.
independent_technical_reasoning: Chassis airflow is zoned, so upper-fan behavior cannot prove the cooling path served by the lower bank. Each lower front rotor must be correlated to its physical FRU and contemporaneous control state; otherwise a healthy neighboring rotor can conceal a localized failure.
